annotationRationale: The method compares the arithmetic mean with the median in all three possible positions, solving and checking a linear equation in each case.
sourceMethod: Follows the official three-case median argument, with both boundary values included in the middle case and each candidate checked against its case.

review.mathCheck: The median is 6, x, or 8 on x<6, 6≤x≤8, or x>8, respectively. Equating each to (x+35)/5 gives -5, 35/4, and 5; only -5 satisfies its case. Endpoints are covered. The sum is -5, choice A.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA 10B solution 13 on pages 5 and 6, using the same three median-position cases and admissibility checks.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed mean and median steps and supporting equation solving match the explanation. All cases are justified and reconstructible at AMC 12 level.
